title: Request body read without size cap
evidence: books_api.py:175 reads Content-Length bytes with no upper bound, so a large Content-Length forces an unbounded in-memory read
suggestion: Reject or stream bodies above a sane maximum (e.g. a few MB)

title: GET /books has no pagination
evidence: books_api.py:225 _list_books returns the full collection unconditionally (not required by TASK.md)
suggestion: Add ?limit/?offset if large collections are expected

title: Single shared SQLite connection serialised by a lock
evidence: books_api.py:44-46 one connection shared across request threads under a threading.Lock, serialising all DB access
suggestion: Use a per-thread/pooled connection if concurrency matters; fine for the spec
